counts_justification: The table is bounded by the top rule below the title and the bottom rule below Omega. Only the title and isolated page footer are outside it. There are 19 particle/antiparticle/mass/charge record tuples: 1 photon + 4 leptons + 5 mesons + 9 baryons. The K-zero record has two lifetime text baselines but only one mass/charge tuple. Header lines, vertical category labels, and merged name text are not additional tuples or outside-table rows.

table.title: 基本粒子表

primary: 质量（以电子质量为单位）
physical_leaf_columns: 质量（以电子质量为单位）
header_merges: 粒子名称 covers the category strip and name column, with no category split in the header.
符号 spans particle and antiparticle columns; its lower header is split vertically.
Mass header is three stacked text lines in one tall cell.
Name, mass, charge and lifetime headers span the two-level symbol header.

relationships: Photon name spans the category strip and ordinary name column; photon is not inside the three later category merges.
轻子 is a vertical merged category over records 2-5; there are no horizontal lines between these four data baselines.
介子 is a vertical merged category over records 6-10. Rules divide pi, K and eta name groups, not every logical record.
π介子 name is merged over two records; K介子 name is merged over two records, and K-zero lifetime has two lines.
重子 is a vertical merged category over records 11-19.
Proton/neutron have separate names and records. A short horizontal rule is present only in the mass column between 1836.1 and 1838.6; the other cells lack a full-row divider.
Λ, Σ, Ξ and Ω group boundaries have horizontal rules across the ordinary columns; category column remains merged.
Σ超子 name spans three records and Ξ超子 name spans two records.

Antiparticle overbar and charge superscript are distinct. Source explicitly prints bar(Σ)^+, bar(Σ)^-, bar(Ξ)^- and bar(Ω)^- with the same displayed superscript sign as their paired particle. Do not invert these signs from theory.

typography.title: centered bold, one horizontal text row
typography.category_labels: 轻/子, 介/子, 重/子 stacked vertically in narrow left strip
typography.symbols: italic Latin/Greek; subscript e, μ, S, L; superscript 0, +, -; overbars on antiparticles
typography.numbers: roman numerals with decimal points; products use ×; lifetime exponents are raised
typography.charge_column: signed integer values, no header unit e added
typography.neutral_K_lifetime_dashes: label/value separators, not minus signs belonging to a numerical coefficient

glyph_holds.reason: Final raised digit is an ink-filled low-resolution glyph. Original, 2x table crop and 6x nearest-neighbor crop do not reliably distinguish its identity. No physics-derived value accepted.

boundaries.start: Standalone table title, not continuation prose.
boundaries.end: Entire table ends at Omega bottom rule; no table continuation marker.
